therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: WEE1 kinase inhibition combined with DNA topoisomerase I inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Cell cycle checkpoint disruption and DNA damage enhancement
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Younger patients with relapsed or refractory solid tumors including CNS embryonal tumors, neuroblastoma, medulloblastoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximum Tolerated Dose (MTD) and dose limiting toxicities

results.effect_size: MTD established: Adavosertib 85 mg/m² + Irinotecan 90 mg/m²
results.target_engagement_evidence: Gamma H2AX fold changes observed (0.45-10 fold increase), indicating DNA damage response activation
biomarker_changes: Gamma H2AX increased 0.45-10 fold at 4 hours post-dose
MYCN amplification detected in 2 neuroblastoma participants
safety_signals: DLTs observed at dose level 5 (2 participants)
Common SAEs: anemia, anorexia, elevated liver enzymes, ataxia
Acute kidney injury in rhabdomyosarcoma cohort
results.dose_information: MTD: Adavosertib 85 mg/m² + Irinotecan 90 mg/m² orally
